messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Action: forecast lockdown — owners update amounts, SKUs, next steps

Team —

We hit the Q3 planning cut-off next Tuesday. Before we hand over to Finance for the official forecast roll-up I need a quick data hygiene pass on all open opportunities assigned to you: amount, primary SKU, next step, and probability. This is a hard requirement for the roll-up — anything not validated will be excluded from the committed numbers.

Attached: pipeline_snapshot_20260915.csv (snapshot filtered to your books) and a short SOP for how to make updates: forecast_entry_sop.docx.

Please do the following by EOD Monday (2026-09-21):
- Confirm ARR/Amount matches contract or written quote. If pending legal/PO, mark notes and leave a conservative amount.
- Ensure a single product/SKU is selected in the product field; if multiple SKUs are required, list the primary SKU and note add-ons in the description.
- Update "Next Step" to one of: Final Proposal, Legal Review, Awaiting PO, Demo Scheduled — no free text.
- Set Probability to one of: 10/30/60/85/95 per the SOP. If you cannot justify a higher bucket, leave at 10.

If anything is stuck on a procurement/workflow item (customer redlines, procurement hold), CC Ben and me so we can coordinate escalations.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Sales — East
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- pipeline_snapshot_20260915.csv (CSV, ~48KB)
- forecast_entry_sop.docx (DOCX, 42KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Action: forecast lockdown — owners update amounts, SKUs, next steps

Thanks for the heads up. A couple of clarifications from Finance so updates roll cleanly into the model:
- Probability buckets need to map to our forecast model: 10% (pipeline), 30% (prospect validated), 60% (proposal sent), 85% (verbal commitment), 95% (PO received). Please do not invent custom percentages.
- Amount: use the committed ARR number. If only a TCV is known, convert to ARR per our standard (TCV / contract_months *12) and note the conversion in the notes column.
- SKU mapping: if a custom bundle is required, map it to the closest catalog SKU and add a comment. We can handle add-ons as separate line items but need a primary SKU for model alignment.

If any opportunity is under procurement review (big legal redlines), flag it as "Procurement Hold" in the Stage and CC procurement@acmecloud.com where appropriate.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Appreciate the quick turn. Final reminders:
- Upload your edited slices to the shared Drive folder and update the HubSpot record link in the CSV.
- I will review large-opps overnight and escalate any Procurement Holds to Acme.
- If you updated probability to 85/95, include the confirmation note (email/PO/exec verbal). We will not accept an 85 without a clear justification.

I'll compile and send the consolidated set to Finance first thing Tuesday morning. If anyone can't meet the Monday deadline, tell me now so we can reassign.

Jonas
